title.zh: 大型赛事直播业务保障

description.zh: 城市马拉松直播保障闭环：保障订阅 → 策略生成 → 功率提升遇节能 SLA 冲突并协商 → KQI 劣化 → 关闭全部节能跨站协同 → KQI 恢复 → 恢复初始配置。
description.en: City-marathon live broadcast assurance closed loop: subscription -> policy -> power boost with energy-saving SLA negotiation -> KQI degradation -> full shutdown with inter-site coordination -> recovery -> initial config restored.

description.zh: mockAgent 驱动的多智能体协作：网络洞察/策略决策/策略执行三个智能体完成 话务洞察 → 节能策略 → A2A-T 执行协商 → 下发 → 反馈 → 复核 闭环，消息内容由 mockAgent 服务返回。
description.en: mockAgent-driven multi-agent collaboration: insight/policy/executor agents close the loop insight -> policy -> A2A-T negotiation -> dispatch -> feedback -> review; message content is returned by the mockAgent service.
